text: Android: no test exercises the hiltViewModel() default — the path every real launch takes

Rejected: setup cost is out of proportion to the benefit.

Standing up the DI graph well enough to boot the real Activity in a simulated
Android runtime is a day's wiring plus a permanent maintenance surface, and what
it buys is one assertion ("the app starts"). The emulator alternative needs a VM
this ARM machine cannot host and would never run in verify-all anyway.

Real-device release-testing already covers this ground: both bugs this class
would have caught (T-129, T-131) were found there within minutes of a release.
That process exists and works, so this would duplicate it at much higher cost.

Revisit only if the app ever needs to be released without a human running it on
a phone first.
